clue.text: To 'ell with American fellow!

parts.note: 'ang it! is the dropped-h Cockney form of the curse hang it, a way of saying to hell with it, giving ANG

explanation.surface: An exasperated cry of 'to hell with him' aimed at some American man.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in 'ell signals the dropped H: 'hang it' becomes 'ang, which is then followed by US.
explanation.definitionFit: Angus is a Scottish man's given name, so it can stand for a fellow in crossword terms.

clue.text: What's on church minister's table? That collar, taken out

indicators.note: taken out suggests the letters are dismantled and put back differently

explanation.surface: A vicar removes his collar and wonders what to lay on the communion table.
explanation.definitionFit: The cloth covering an altar is what lies on the table where clergy celebrate communion.

clue.text: School sport never ending

indicators.note: never ending says the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a game is a sport

explanation.surface: School sport that seems to go on for ever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'School' looks like a place of learning, but it is a group of whales.
explanation.definitionFit: A gam is a school or pod of whales, a crossword-friendly collective noun.

clue.text: Configurations of sheep in Sussex, say?

indicators.note: in says the sheep are found in the region, so the region comes first

parts.note: Sussex is a county in South East England, abbreviated SE
tups are rams, male sheep

explanation.surface: How sheep are arranged on a Sussex farm.
explanation.walkthrough: Sussex is a county on England's south coast; 'say' marks it as an example of the South East.
explanation.definitionFit: Arrangements of equipment or organisations are their configurations.

clue.text: A song about knight and goddess out of love?

indicators.note: about means the song word wraps around the knight and goddess pieces

parts.note: a lied is a German art song
N is the chess notation for a knight
Ate is the Greek goddess of mischief and ruin

explanation.surface: A ballad about a knight and a goddess, sung by someone whose romance has ended.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone estranged from a former partner has had their affection turned away, no longer loving.

clue.text: A type turning up in clerical garments, one bringing sense of guilt?

indicators.note: in places the turned pieces inside the vestment word

parts.note: albs are white vestments worn by clergy

indicators.note: turning up in a down clue means reading the word from bottom to top

parts.note: a sort is a type or kind

explanation.surface: A sort of person in priestly robes who stirs up guilt.
explanation.walkthrough: From Coleridge's Ancient Mariner, who shot the seabird and wore it round his neck as a burden of guilt.
explanation.definitionFit: The seabird worn round the mariner's neck became a byword for a burden of guilt.

clue.text: Perfection to be seen in bride always

indicators.note: to be seen in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A bride's perfect appearance on her wedding day.
explanation.definitionFit: A model of excellence, the perfect standard, is perfection itself.

clue.text: Code number on establishment initially obscured

indicators.note: on in a down clue puts the number above the following piece
initially obscured says the first letter of the word is hidden away

parts.note: a station is an establishment, such as a military or research base

explanation.surface: A code number on a building, partly hidden.
explanation.definitionFit: A system of symbols, as in musical or chess notation, is a kind of code.

clue.text: Thor blunted? Then that's tricky!

indicators.note: tricky suggests the letters are shuffled into a deceptive order

explanation.surface: If the god Thor's power were blunted, he'd be in a tricky spot.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is wordplay and definition: Thor's weapon, his weapon of lightning, would make him tricky to face.
explanation.definitionFit: Thor, the Norse god, hurls lightning strikes; his mighty bolt is what the clue evokes.

clue.text: Perform exercises — will this improve performance unfairly?

parts.note: to do is to perform an action
PE is physical education, school exercises

explanation.surface: An athlete working out wonders whether drugs would boost results.
explanation.definitionFit: Drugs taken by athletes to enhance performance are illegal stimulants in sporting slang.

clue.text: Magazine board establishing schedule for publication?

parts.note: Time is a well-known American news magazine
a table is a board, as in board and lodging or a festive board

explanation.surface: A magazine's editorial board setting out a schedule for when issues are printed.
explanation.definitionFit: A published list of times, such as for trains, is a schedule made public; the question mark flags the pun.

clue.text: Finally eat what's left over in club maybe

indicators.note: Finally points to the closing letter of the word eat

parts.note: a rump is a remnant, the part left over

explanation.surface: Finishing off leftovers at a club dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'club' looks like a social club, but it is the card suit.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games, clubs may be the boss suit that beats all others; maybe marks it as one example.

clue.text: Soldiers yielded to enemy, as reported in summary

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
to capitulate is to surrender to an enemy

explanation.surface: A summary news report says the soldiers surrendered.
explanation.definitionFit: To recap is to restate the main points briefly, so something so described has been summarised.

clue.text: Consider scorn English displayed about the French

indicators.note: about says the scorn and English pieces go round the French article

parts.note: contempt is scorn
la is French for the, feminine form

explanation.surface: Consider the scorn the English showed towards the French.
explanation.definitionFit: To ponder or think over carefully is to consider something.

clue.text: Eight nudes cavorting around in good health!

indicators.note: cavorting suggests the letters leap about into a new order

explanation.surface: Eight naked people prancing about in fine fettle.
explanation.definitionFit: The German toast or response to a sneeze wishes someone well, literally meaning health.

clue.text: Wild animal reportedly …

indicators.note: reportedly says the word for the next clue's venue is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: the ellipsis carries on into the next clue, whose seaside golf course is the links

explanation.surface: Read with the next clue: a wild animal reportedly loose on a golf course.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links the two clues: 'in this sporting venue' from the next clue is the word said aloud, LINKS, a seaside golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: The lynx is a wild cat with tufted ears, found in forests of Europe, Asia and North America.

clue.text: … in this sporting venue that's suffering closure with fog

indicators.note: suffering suggests the letters are knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: A sports venue shut down because of fog.
explanation.definitionFit: A place laid out for the game with clubs and holes is a venue for sport.

clue.text: Spooner's angry quarrel that may come with a premonition

definitions.text: that may come with a premonition

indicators.note: Spooner's says the opening sounds of two words are swapped

parts.note: sore means angry or aggrieved, especially in American usage
a fight is a quarrel

explanation.surface: A furious row that someone saw coming.
explanation.definitionFit: Being able to anticipate events goes along with a sense of what is coming.

clue.text: Something to mop overturned spirit or beer

parts.note: you mop your brow when hot

indicators.note: overturned in a down clue says the word is turned upside down

parts.note: elan is spirit, dash or verve

explanation.surface: Something to mop up a spilt drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mop' looks like a cleaning tool for spills, but it is what you do to your forehead.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark, sweetish bottled British beer is one variety of beer.

clue.text: People with ideas shoot up, surrounded by others getting excited

indicators.note: surrounded by puts the climbing word inside the agitated letters
getting excited signals the letters of others are stirred up

parts.note: to shoot up is to rise sharply

explanation.surface: Thinkers whose ideas take off, ringed by an excitable crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who devise theories are thinkers who produce ideas and hypotheses.

clue.text: Superior group set about providing something fragrant

indicators.note: set about tells us to turn the pieces round and read them backwards

parts.note: U stands for upper class, socially superior
a lot is a group or batch

explanation.surface: A snobbish set starting to provide perfume.
explanation.definitionFit: Tolu is an aromatic balsam from a South American tree, used in perfumes and cough syrups.

clue.text: Having account put up, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the word for put up is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: to build is to put up a structure

explanation.surface: Someone who has had an invoice put up on the wall.
explanation.definitionFit: A person charged by invoice has been sent an account to pay.

clue.text: New waste-disposer not operated completely manually

indicators.note: New suggests the letters are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A new kitchen waste-disposal unit that doesn't need hand cranking.
explanation.definitionFit: Steering or brakes with a motor helping the driver's effort are not purely worked by hand.

clue.text: Entertainment always set up outside university

indicators.note: outside means the turned word goes round the university letter
set up in a down clue means reading the word upwards

parts.note: ever means always

explanation.surface: A university entertainment that is always staged.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatrical show of sketches and songs is a form of entertainment.

clue.text: Failure of a dandy, about fifty

indicators.note: about says the dandy goes round the number fifty

parts.note: a fop is a dandy
L is fifty in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A dandy approaching fifty proves a failure.
explanation.definitionFit: A show or venture that fails badly is a flop, a damp squib.

clue.text: Pin back a plant

indicators.note: back means the word for pin is read in reverse

parts.note: a nail is a metal pin driven into wood

explanation.surface: Pinning back a plant, perhaps to train it against a wall.
explanation.definitionFit: A liana is a woody climbing vine of tropical forests.

clue.text: After six soldier has time in road for one keeping watch

indicators.note: After says the soldier comes following the number six

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
GI is an American soldier

indicators.note: in places the time letter inside the road word

parts.note: a lane is a narrow road

explanation.surface: At six o'clock a soldier stands in the road on sentry duty.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-appointed guardian patrols a neighbourhood, watching out for wrongdoers.

clue.text: Horse that can barely win giving trouble?

definitions.meaning: an old or worn-out horse unlikely to win races
to pester or keep complaining at someone

explanation.definitionFit: An aged horse is a poor racer; and to pester constantly is to cause annoyance.

clue.text: Quietly retreat with holy books — a pattern already established

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quietly
to recede is to move back or retreat
NT is the New Testament, a collection of holy books

explanation.surface: Withdrawing quietly with scripture, following an old pattern.
explanation.definitionFit: An earlier case or decision serves as a model that later ones follow.

clue.text: One perhaps giving advice to gardener with hard ground

definitions.meaning: one is an example of a single figure from nought to nine

definitions.text: giving advice to gardener with hard ground
definitions.meaning: split as two words, the phrase is an urging to turn over firm soil with a spade

explanation.surface: Someone offering tips to a gardener struggling with compacted soil.
explanation.definitionFit: A numeral such as one is a single figure; the split phrase is a spade instruction.
